data.description:
## Description

**What**: New directory plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/ with README.md as the index documenting which sub-file the architect-foundation/dialogue phases load at which step; tags each sub-file silent vs dialog. Initial sub-file scaffolds (config-writes.md, arch-enforcement.md, posture-dialog.md, posture-writer.md) committed as empty stubs that emit \"not yet implemented\" errors so the directory structure validates.
**Why**: README is the contract for phase wiring; sub-files are the units the phase mechanism Reads.
**Scope**:
- IN: README.md mapping each sub-file to phase + step + silent/dialog tag; empty stubs of all four sub-files; subdirectory created in plugin filesystem.
- OUT: Sub-file contents (separate stories); phase wiring (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, README.md documents sub-file/phase/step/tag mapping per the epic In Scope spec ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, all four sub-file stubs exist; absence of any sub-file produces the version-skew error ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for README schema validation

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] README is the contract — phase wiring story Reads it; do not drift

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an onboarding maintainer, prompts/strata/ directory exists with a documented sub-file/phase mapping
